events.verdict: Looney (GSW) legally defends Vucevic (ORL) in the post using a bent hand. Looney then briefly grasps Vucevic's jersey, but the contact is marginal and does not affect his SQBR.
LAR shows Iguodala (GSW) makes clean contact with the ball prior to any incidental contact with Vucevic (ORL) in the post.
Thompson (GSW) and Fournier (ORL) briefly engage and disengage on the perimeter.
Iguodala (GSW) reflexively places his arms around Isaac's (ORL) midsection as the pick is set, but releases without affecting his FOM.
Vucevic (ORL) and Looney (GSW) engage and disengage as they move through the lane.
LAR shows Looney (GSW) briefly places two hands against Vucevic's (ORL) back, but the contact is marginal.
Looney (GSW) sets the screen on Fournier (ORL) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Vucevic (ORL) moves laterally into Durant's (GSW) path and creates body contact after his gather that affects his shot attempt.
Thompson (GSW) briefly places his hand on Ross's (ORL) inside hip and makes marginal contact that does not affect his FOM.
Durant (GSW) sets the pick on Fournier (ORL) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Fournier (ORL) briefly places his arm around Looney's (GSW) midsection as the screen is set and makes contact that is tactile in nature.
Looney (GSW) sets the screen on Fournier (ORL) and allows him to move around it after initial contact takes place. Looney subsequently absorbs contact from Fournier.

Thompson (GSW) briefly places his forearm against Ross's (ORL) side after his gather and makes marginal body contact. After the shot is released, LLB shows Thompson makes incidental "high-five" contact with Ross and does not affect his ability to follow-through naturally.
Isaac (ORL) makes incidental "high-five" contact with Durant (GSW) and does not affect his ability to follow-through naturally.
Thompson (GSW) briefly places his hand on Ross's (ORL) right hip during the inbound and makes marginal contact that does not affect his FOM.
Vucevic (ORL) sets the screen on Livingston (GSW) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Vucevic (ORL) establishes himself in a screening position in Thompson's (GSW) defensive path and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Thompson (GSW) wraps Vucevic's (ORL) opposite side hip as he rolls toward the basket.
Livingston (GSW) places his hand to Fournier's (ORL) inside hip during the inbound and makes contact that is tactile in nature.
Fournier (ORL) commits a take foul on Livingston (GSW).
Vucevic (ORL) briefly grasps Thompson's (GSW) right arm and makes marginal contact that does not affect his ability to defend.
LAR shows that Fournier (ORL) jumps to his side and creates the marginal contact with Livingston (GSW).
Vucevic (ORL) commits a take foul on Durant (GSW).
